name: gear_loop
description: The party stat builder and the battle-start gear loop: what two worn pieces (four ability words and a crit byte each) make of a party member. Every one of the 134 auto-ability records alone on the weapon and on the armour, then random sets of real, percent-heavy, resistance-heavy, junk and auto-status words (the same ability on several slots counts several times).

function.signature: void build_party_stats(int slot); void battle_gear_loop(int slot)

harness.note: the real machine code of both functions with the real a_ability table behind the game pointer; nothing is replaced but the menu rebuild, which is recorded and does not run (no vector learns a Fury)

notes: in.baseHp and in.baseMp are the save record HP and MP after the Sphere Grid (bonus record zero); in.crits are the gear rows crit bytes (weapon, armour); in.words are the weapon four then the armour four ability words (0 and 255 are empty slots).

out.pct is the four damage bytes (physical dealt, magical dealt, physical taken, magical taken); chances, durations and resist are sparse [index, byte] lists (status number, temporal slot, status number).
out.auto and out.sos are the three auto words (permanent, counter, extra) of the normal and the SOS trio; out.words is words A, B and C.
